notes: Source: every note came from the live collection on Sep 29 (3,206 unique notes), before the later Morsanki reconciliation pass added AnKing cards to built lectures. Cards were counted from each note's actual card list. The Morsanki numbers match the counts published in its add-on within ±5 cards on all 28 rows
L04 is left out: nobody built it for Manhattanki, and everyone used Morsanki for it

Labs: on lab days the Morsanki add-on puts the lab rows (Gluteal, Anterior Thigh, Posterior Leg) under the postlab ELs, so they are compared against L15, L23 and L27. The Gluteal lab row also re-opens all 190 L04 prelab notes through its Anatomy:: tag; those are taken out, so L15 is 71 notes / 145 cards (the add-on shows 382)

Double counting: the L23 and L27 lab rows re-open the whole prelab tag. Adding up the add-on rows gives 3,492 Morsanki cards, but only 2,807 are different cards. Manhattanki rows add up to 1,622, and 1,444 are different cards (105 notes sit under more than one lecture)
Manhattanki add-on counts were stale on a few rows on Sep 29: L16 121 (published 92), L19 116 (102), L20 93 (69), L10 67 (59), L07 57 (64)

Left out: optional rows (Vaccine Spam, 54 IO cards, and the Morsanki "C1T3L01 (AnKing)" row). Nathanki appears in both add-ons; the collection has no nathanglutepl or shivanshuantlab cards, so those couldn't be measured

Postlab EL Posterior Leg & Foot (Lab row)

takeaways: Manhattanki was 51% of Morsanki's size (1,444 vs 2,807 cards), and had more cards on only 4 of 28 lectures: L01, L11, L17, L20
Regular lectures: Manhattanki was 66% of Morsanki's size. Anatomy labs: 29%, mostly Morsanki's lab image-occlusion sets (386 IO notes vs 57)
63% of Manhattanki's AnKing picks are also in Morsanki. Biggest AnKing cuts: L10 (13 vs 65), L02 (28 vs 53), L24 (21 vs 45), L26 (10 vs 28)
Manhattanki tagged more AnKing than Morsanki on 8 lectures: L01, L05, L11, L12, L16, L17, L19, L20

notes: Source: the live collection on Oct 27 (3,785 unique notes across both decks). Cards were counted from each note's actual card list. Morsanki's published counts match on 26 of 27 rows; L05 is published as 89 but now holds 93

Compared: L02 to L28, every lecture built so far. L01 (the course intro) is never built. L29 to L31 unlock on Morsanki today and tomorrow but are not built in Manhattanki yet; the Morsanki L32 row (EL: Development of CV) has no tags. The optional Blood Virtual Microscopy row is left out

Anatomy: the L04 and L13 Morsanki prelab rows each open both their lab tag and their anatomy lecture tag. The L10 and L24 postlabs have their own rows and do not re-open the prelab tags. Manhattanki L04 includes BlueLink atlas image-occlusion notes. L15 (microanatomy) and L16 (cardiac imaging) are counted as regular lectures. The add-on's L09 row opens a tag filed under Morsanki's Test 2

Double counting: Morsanki rows add up to 3,642 cards, but only 3,575 are different cards (58 notes sit under two rows). Manhattanki rows add up to 2,473, with 2,380 different (65 notes sit under two or more lectures)

Manhattanki only tags an AnKing card when the lecture mentions its fact. The Oct 13 mention check removed unmentioned AnKing cards from L02, L03 and L05, which is most of the L02 and L03 AnKing gap. Of the 267 AnKing notes only Morsanki unlocks, AnKing rates 77 as high yield, 77 relatively high, 44 high yield (temporary), 49 lower, 10 low and 10 unrated

takeaways: Manhattanki is 67% of Morsanki's size so far (2,380 vs 3,575 cards over 27 lectures). The three newest lectures are L26 (62 vs 70), L27 (44 vs 97) and L28 (91 vs 248)
Regular lectures: Manhattanki is 61% of Morsanki's size (1,875 vs 3,062). Anatomy (two prelabs and two postlabs): 102% (536 vs 523), with 225 image-occlusion notes vs 217
76% of Morsanki's AnKing picks are also in Manhattanki, and 81% of Manhattanki's are in Morsanki. Biggest AnKing cuts: L28 (50 vs 112), L12 (108 vs 154), L02 (36 vs 78) and L03 (26 vs 47)
Manhattanki has more cards on L04 (168 vs 160), L10 (56 vs 47), L13 (280 vs 232) and L16 (67 vs 66), and tagged more AnKing on L04, L05, L06, L08, L09, L10, L13, L15, L16, L18 and L20
